_comment: HARPS-tuned regular-grid example for Fe NLTE synthesis using per-abundance ASCII departure files.
_harps: HARPS = High Accuracy Radial velocity Planet Searcher, the fibre-fed echelle spectrograph on the ESO 3.6 m at La Silla.
Resolving power R ~ 115000 -> turbospectrum.overrides.synthesis_parameters.resolution = 115000.0 convolves output to the instrument profile.
Wavelength coverage 3780-6910 A across two CCDs, with a physical gap at ~5304-5337 A (between the blue and red detectors).

CCD GAP NOTE: this pipeline writes a single contiguous LAMBDA_MIN/MAX/STEP window to bsyn; segments_file is NOT wired through the Python wrapper. For detector-faithful spectra, either mask 5304-5337 A downstream, or run two passes - blue CCD = 3780/5304 and red CCD = 5337/6910 - and concatenate.

NLTE COST: Fe NLTE over the full 3780-6910 A window (~313k lambda points) is expensive. The grid below is deliberately tiny (3 x 2 x 2 = 12 points). Scale up cautiously and prefer chunked shards on HPC.
_note: This example focuses on the Fe NLTE ASCII-departure selection workflow at HARPS resolution.
Update the Turbospectrum path overrides for your local checkout or cluster environment before a full synthesis run.
When synthesized, turbvel is preserved as a numeric parameter column alongside vmicro in the final spectra Zarr.
These fields are copied into the generated grid and used at synthesis time.
For Fe, abundance_column='feh' with abundance_scale='relative' maps A(Fe)=solar_fe+[Fe/H] on the Magg abundance scale used by the synthesis runner.
match='nearest' chooses the closest available _abu+X.XXX ASCII file for the selected model atmosphere.
Base synthesis runtime config used by synthesize_spectra_from_zarr.py.
overrides turns on NLTE Fe, sets the HARPS resolution, and points at the repository NLTE info file.

outputs._note: run_root is resolved relative to this config unless absolute; output paths under outputs/... are resolved relative to run_root.

runtime._note: rows_per_shard helps amortize Turbospectrum startup overhead on HPC and works with the regular-grid PBS array mode.
